name: Meter
intent: How far along or how full something is, from 0 to 100, as a bar, a ring or a half ring, with optional red, amber and green zones.
usage: Use Meter for task completion (uploads, setup) and for measures against a range (storage used, budget spent, health scores). It is one component: pass value from 0 to 100 and a label that names it. shape picks a bar, a circle or a semicircle gauge (a bowl that fills left to right); size sets the bar thickness or the ring width. thresholds splits the range into thirds, low red, middle amber, high green: bar colors the value by its zone, plotArea colors the track, all shows the three bands. referenceLines marks the zone edges. showValue writes the percent after the bar or inside the ring, and datatip puts a short note in a tip at the end of the value. See contracts/meter.json for the full contract.

label.note: Names it for screen readers, like Storage used.

shape.note: bar fills its container's width. circle is a ring that fills clockwise from the top. semicircle is a bowl: 0 to 100 runs from its left tip, under, to its right tip.

size.note: Bar: 4 / 8 / 12 tall. Circle and semicircle: 56 / 96 / 196 wide.

thresholds.note: Zones are thirds: under 33 is red, under 67 amber, the rest green. none: blue value on a gray track. bar: the value takes its zone's color. plotArea: the track takes the value's zone color under a blue value. all: the track shows all three bands under a blue value.

intent.note: Sets the value's color outright, whatever thresholds says, when the screen knows what the value means, like amber for a limit that is nearly used up. Leave it out for the blue value or the threshold zones.

referenceLines.note: Marks at the zone edges, a third and two thirds along.

showValue.note: The rounded percent: after the bar, or inside the ring.

datatip.note: A short note in a tip at the end of the value, like $6,000 of $10,000.

useWhen: Task completion with a known percent: uploads, imports, onboarding.
A measure against a range, like storage, budget or a score, where red, amber and green zones help people judge it.
A color the screen decides, like a usage limit going amber and red: set intent.
doNot: Do not use it for waits of unknown length. Show a spinner.
Do not draw bars or rings from divs or SVG. Use Meter.
Do not add a MeterLabel, MeterCircle or ProgressCircle. Pick shape.
Do not use intent and thresholds bar together. intent wins; pick one.
Do not rely on the zone colors alone; say what the value means in the label, showValue or datatip.
For screens that still use the older 20-tall bar, use ProgressBar.
a11y: role progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin 0 and aria-valuemax 100, named by label.
aria-valuetext is the percent, followed by the datatip when there is one.
The drawing is decorative; the percent and datatip text are hidden from screen readers because the progressbar already reads them.
snippet: <Meter label="Budget spent" value={60} thresholds="all" referenceLines datatip="$6,000 of $10,000" />
